2608.16697.title: FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy
2608.16697.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. Although VLAs' architectures differ in their action generation, we show that they share a common latent action generation abstraction evolving under visual perception, language instruction, and state input, which we formulate as a Conditional Generative Markov Chain. Based on this formulation, we propose MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), a self-evaluation framework that directly converts internal attention signals into architecture-aware reliability scores, and introduce LIBERO-Reflect, a 4,000-episode benchmark combining 2,000 standard episodes and 2,000 challenging episodes across four subsets. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous VLA architectures and diverse scenarios show that MAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. We further instantiate FabriMAE for verifier-free test-time action selection, showing that MAE-guided multiple sampling improves PI-family robustness on LIBERO-Plus with small observed runtime overhead.
2608.16697.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動模型（VLA）將視覺感知、語言指令和行動生成整合到跨異構架構的端到端政策中。<lb/>然而，使VLA能夠在沒有外部監督的情況下自我評估其行動生成的可靠性仍然是一個主要挑戰。<lb/>現有方法要麼依賴專家註釋，要麼僅從輸出統計中估計不確定性，主要忽略了內部信號。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們觀察到內部視覺模態的熵在異構VLA中成功和失敗任務之間顯示出一致的區別。<lb/>儘管VLA的架構在其行動生成上有所不同，我們展示了它們共享一個在視覺感知、語言指令和狀態輸入下演變的共同潛在行動生成抽象，我們將其表述為條件生成馬爾可夫鏈。<lb/>基於這一表述，我們提出了MAE（馬爾可夫注意力熵），這是一個自我評估框架，能夠直接將內部注意力信號轉換為架構感知的可靠性分數，並引入LIBERO-Reflect，一個結合2,000個標準回合和2,000個挑戰回合的4,000回合基準，涵蓋四個子集。<lb/>在異構VLA架構和多樣場景中的廣泛實驗顯示，MAE在AUPR、AUROC和FPR@95上始終超越最先進的基準。<lb/>我們進一步實現了FabriMAE，用於無驗證者的測試時行動選擇，顯示MAE引導的多次取樣在LIBERO-Plus上提高了PI家族的穩健性，並且觀察到的運行時間開銷很小。
